stories.title: Enforce Canonical Provider Search Contract
stories.description: Harden and align Pydantic models to enforce strict input/output schema (query, specialty, geo, filters, ranked providers, scores, metadata), including normalization (location, specialty codes) and validation boundaries with zero domain logic leakage.

stories.title: Implement Vector Search with Deterministic Fallback Boundary
stories.description: Implement provider_search_service pipeline: embedding generation via embedding_client, MongoDB Atlas vector search, explicit score threshold evaluation, deterministic fallback to NUCC taxonomy, and staged geo filtering (state→city→county) with consistent ordering guarantees.

stories.title: Orchestrate Provider Search via Facade and Tool Router
stories.description: Wire provider search through find_care_facade and tool_router, explicitly defining API/tool contract boundaries (inputs, outputs, error handling). Integrate specialty_service (dual-pipeline identification), query expansion, and provider_search_service execution while preserving strict orchestration vs domain separation and allowlist dispatch.

stories.title: Comprehensive Test Coverage for Search Ranking and Fallback
stories.description: Add unit and integration tests validating ranking determinism, threshold-triggered fallback behavior, geo filtering stages, specialty matching consistency, and edge cases (no hits, low-confidence matches, malformed inputs).

stories.title: Validate End-to-End Embedding and Search Integration
stories.description: Validate alignment between offline provider embeddings (DataPipelines) and runtime retrieval: ensure embedding consistency, index integrity, query expansion compatibility, and environment parity (dev/qa/prod) for stable search results.
